    <article class="entry">
      <p class="entry__when">4–5 June<span>2026</span></p>
      <div>
        <h3>II International Workshop on Bayesian Statistics</h3>
        <p class="entry__where">CUNEF Universidad, Madrid</p>
        <p>A single-track meeting of seven keynote lectures and five contributed sessions, covering model selection, Bayesian computation, spatial and temporal modelling, financial econometrics, adversarial and robust machine learning, and applied Bayesian methods. Organised with CUNEF Universidad and funded by SEIO and CUNEF Universidad; registration was free of charge. The closing session announced the winner of the María Eugenia Castellanos Award.</p>
        <p class="entry__links"><a href="conference.html">Workshop archive</a><a href="program.html">Programme</a><a href="book_of_abstracts_bayes_cunef.pdf">Book of abstracts</a><a href="about.html">Venue and committees</a></p>
      </div>
    </article>

    <article class="entry">
      <p class="entry__when">17–18 June<span>2024</span></p>
      <div>
        <h3>I International Workshop on Bayesian Statistics</h3>
        <p class="entry__where">Universidad Carlos III de Madrid, Puerta de Toledo campus</p>
        <p>The first edition brought together 37 participants for 17 talks.</p>
        <details>
          <summary>Speakers and scientific committee</summary>
          <div>
            <p><strong>Keynote speakers.</strong> Alan Gelfand (Duke University), Simon Wilson (Trinity College Dublin) and Miguel Ángel Gómez Villegas (Universidad Complutense de Madrid / Universidad CEU San Pablo).</p>
            <p><strong>Invited speakers.</strong> María Eugenia Castellanos (Universidad Rey Juan Carlos), David Conesa (Universitat de València), Gonzalo García-Donato (Universidad de Castilla-La Mancha), Rosario Susi (Universidad Complutense de Madrid) and Pilar Gargallo (Universidad de Zaragoza).</p>
            <p><strong>Scientific committee.</strong> Conchi Ausín, Stefano Cabras, Juanmi Díaz-Araque, Pepa Ramírez-Cobo and Mike Wiper.</p>
          </div>
        </details>
        <p class="entry__links"><a href="https://seio-bayes.webnode.es/first-international-workshop-on-bayesian-statistics/">Original event page</a></p>
      </div>

        <p>The group was constituted as a point of reference within SEIO for researchers working on Bayesian inference.</p>
